postconditions.description: If it is impossible to find an array a, output 'NO'. Otherwise, output 'YES' followed by k integers.

postconditions.expression: sum(int(x) for x in stdout.split()[1:]) == n
postconditions.description: The sum of all elements in the array a must equal n.

postconditions.expression: all(int(a[i]) < int(a[i+1]) <= 2 * int(a[i]) for i in range(k-1))
postconditions.description: Each element in the array a must satisfy the condition a[i] < a[i+1] <= 2 * a[i].
The array a must contain exactly k unique elements.
